summary: Last supplement the remaining budget allowed, with a real effect on the durable record: the identity finding's knowledge entry now cites both sides of its measured boundary — event 1 of receipt 743518e2, the false completion where the caller's entry was overwritten at its assigned index (a_entry_at_index_1_is_own false, Ok(1)), and event 2 of receipt 78c53df3, the scope control where the entry was adopted and the same call is truthful (a_entry_at_index_1_is_own true, Ok(1)). Its statement, conditions and sources are unchanged, so nothing was rewritten gratuitously; the 'not adopted by the following leader' condition now points at the evidence that supports it. That closes the per-turn budget. Final position: four findings with receipts, knowledge and scoped limits — the actor layer's event egress parks the loop and, once enough nodes park, stops the cluster deciding (capacities 8/64/1024, corrected per-destination transport, 21.69s retrospective bound, superseded transport-jam run retained as an excluded cause); the core has no timer-driven repair for a lost Accepted reply, measured at two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses and only heartbeats on the wire afterwards; append_notify can resolve Ok for an index occupied by another entry, bounded to unadopted entries with the adopted case shown truthful; and the actor layer owns the instance but offers no compaction path, with the panic-to-Shutdown attribution chain and the repository's own compaction documentation as the norm. The single declared unfinished measurement remains the failure side of that last finding — a Storage whose write returns Err driven through the actor — which needs a delegating Storage wrapper and is recorded as the question's next discriminator, not as a claim.
